author: Zig Ziglar
quotes: A clear goal gives daily effort somewhere useful to travel.
Success becomes richer when it helps another person succeed.
Your attitude influences how effectively your ability can be used.
Character is built through choices too small for public recognition.
You can begin imperfectly and still finish remarkably well.
A goal without a plan remains a pleasant conversation.
Encouragement costs little and may change the direction of someone’s day.
Honest service creates opportunities manipulation cannot sustain.
Your words should strengthen the trust your actions are building.
Progress starts when intention receives a date and a next step.
Optimism is not ignorance; it is a decision to search for possibilities.
A good reputation is earned slowly through dependable conduct.
Prepare carefully enough that opportunity recognizes you as ready.
Helping people solve real problems is the strongest form of persuasion.
Your destination matters, but so does the person you become while traveling.
Small improvements repeated faithfully can produce a very large life.
Do not let one disappointing result become a permanent expectation.
Gratitude improves the view without requiring the road to be easy.
A sincere promise should be followed by visible behavior.
Confidence grows when preparation and integrity agree with each other.
Your family should benefit from your success, not merely hear about it.
Set goals that organize your effort rather than decorate your imagination.
Enthusiasm becomes credible when supported by competence.
Treat people well before knowing whether they can advance your interests.
Build success through service, planning, persistence, and trustworthy character.
